title: Assassin's Creed
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#901, 2026-11-02), Apple M1, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.24, engine x64-crossover26.3-r28, D3DMetal, rated 2 of 5 after 5 minutes: the title screen runs at 7 fps and the game crashes on the way in. The logo ran in slow motion on the Wine 10 engine r29 and normally on the Wine 11 engine. Not verified by the maintainer. udance4ever again on highball-db#901 (2026-11-03): with ROSETTA_X87_PATH set for athei's x87sidecar the title screen stutter didn't change, but that run's log has no sidecar attach line, so the sidecar most likely wasn't active. udance4ever again on highball-db#901 (2026-11-04) showed ROSETTA_X87_PATH set correctly in the environment's variables. Highball 0.10.25 removes a ROSETTA_X87_PATH set by hand and sets it only itself, when the environment has HB_X87SIDECAR=1 and its engine ships the sidecar (the Wine 11 engines r30 and r31, Highball 0.10.26), so a hand-set path never reaches Wine there. So the 2026-11-03 sidecar test didn't run with the sidecar. udance4ever again on highball-db#901 (2026-11-06), the Wine 11 engine r30 with athei's x87sidecar switched on (HB_X87SIDECAR=1 in the environment's variables, Highball 0.10.26), DXVK: the game is snappy at about 40 fps and plays through the campaign. A controller is only used after choosing Xbox 360 controller in the game's controller settings with the mouse, at every start, a tip from a Steam community discussion. With a DualSense, RT isn't recognized, even through Steam Input, so the reporter mapped High Profile to RB, Action Camera to L3 and Center Camera to R3.
notes: Plays in one report on an M1 on the Wine 11 engine r30 with athei's x87sidecar switched on (HB_X87SIDECAR=1 in the environment's variables, Highball 0.10.26) and DXVK, at about 40 fps (highball-db#901). Without the sidecar the title screen ran at about 7 fps, and D3DMetal crashed on the way in. Choose the controller in the game's settings at every start. It's a 32-bit game.

knownIssues.symptom: The title screen stutters at about 7 fps and the game crashes on the way in (M1, Wine 11 r28, D3DMetal)
knownIssues.fix: put the environment on the Wine 11 engine r30 or r31, add HB_X87SIDECAR=1 to its variables and use DXVK. The game is then snappy at about 40 fps on an M1 (highball-db#901, 2026-11-06, credit udance4ever). On DXVK it doesn't crash

knownIssues.symptom: The opening logo plays in slow motion on the Wine 10 engine
knownIssues.fix: the Wine 11 engine plays it normally

knownIssues.symptom: No controller input until a controller is chosen in the game's settings, at every start. On a DualSense RT isn't recognized
knownIssues.fix: with the mouse, open the game's controller settings and scroll to Xbox 360 controller, then apply. On a DualSense map High Profile to RB, Action Camera to L3 and Center Camera to R3 (highball-db#901, credit udance4ever, from a Steam community discussion)
